metadata.description: Free Claude Code plugins from Remix Systems for people who run a personal AI operating system on a folder of Markdown notes.

plugins.name: command-center
plugins.description: See your personal AI operating system from different sides. Lenses for a health score out of 100, your level from 1 to 5, and a Wrapped of your habit over a season. Reads files on your machine, uploads nothing.

plugins.name: cold-read
plugins.description: Test any document the way its reader will meet it, cold. A fresh agent with no context reads only the file and the original ask, grades it on eight points, and Claude fixes and re-reads until it passes.
